comment: Channel catalogue for dsh-gateway. Language-neutral: the Python sidecar serves it (as the settings page's field schema) and the browser half renders it. Field `name` values are the config keys octop-gateway accepts, which include its `field_aliases`. Each kind also carries `blurb`, the one-line description the settings page shows on its platform tile; it states how that platform is configured, nothing about the host. A channel's display name is not in here: the host derives it as `<label>-<6-character id>` when the channel is created. `identity` names the control whose value is the account's id on the platform (the App ID, the bot UIN): the host refuses to configure one account twice, because two live channels polling one bot fight over the same session.

weixin.comment: WeixinConfig declares only `accounts`; its from_dict also accepts this flat single-account form, so these keys are declared here rather than in the dataclass.

quickConfig.comment: only: no manual entry when creating (the flat single-account form is still editable afterwards). autoCreate: the scan itself creates the channel, so no field is hand-typed.

qq.comment: quickConfig.mode=qr: the gateway library owns a two-phase QR binding flow for this kind, so the settings page offers scan-to-create beside manual entry. Credential keys are the library's own and are mapped by the sidecar.

groups.description: agent 回复里哪些过程信息会转发到 IM。
groups.comment: Shared by every kind, so the copy here must not name a platform: a group without `kinds` renders under all of them, and a platform named in a control would show up where it does not apply. A caveat that belongs to one platform goes in `kindNotices`, keyed by that kind. `order` places the card on the settings page; the host-side session card sits at 20 (see core/spec/README.md).

groups.title: 群聊策略
groups.description: 控制机器人能看到哪些群消息，以及什么时候启动 Agent 回复。
groups.comment: Only kinds that actually deliver group messages are listed. weixin has no group surface (iLink is direct-only); dingtalk reports group conversations but never marks a bot mention, so mention-based activation can never fire there.

kindNotices.dingtalk: 钉钉的群消息不带 @ 标记，选「仅被 @ 时回复」不会有消息进来。要用群聊请把可见范围设为「全部消息」、触发方式设为「每条消息都回复」。

warnWhen.text: 机器人会回复群内每一条可见消息，可能产生较多消息和模型调用。
